mediator_selection: Unchanged V14 public development-median checkpoint; no fresh selection or optimization.
architecture: Stage1 V10 motion_only public-history core on RAW reference commands. Freeze all stage1 parameters. Stage2 separate V10 plain anchored response core, unused motion head frozen, RAW or frozen-public-CBF estimated action inputs. Final prediction=original GRU+same frozen common motion+response. Stage2 cannot mutate or backpropagate into common motion. Raw/mediated stage2 initialization and sampler matched per seed.
input_contract: Public8x252 history, delayed4x6 relative context, frozen supplied GRU8x3, raw proposed/anchor8x4x3; frozen estimated commands only for mediated response core. Common motion always uses raw reference. Private target/branch/executed/valid/termination only labels/masks. No original or mediator optimizer.
loss: Stage1 group-balanced reference-motion MSE plus .001 motion energy. Stage2 group-balanced valid nonanchor paired response MSE plus .001 response energy, with common motion entirely excluded from graph. No label-window sampling or imputed padding, task-loss sweep, best-epoch selection, or predicted-minimum-cost reward.
normalization: Fresh train public histories only, std floor .01. Frozen mediator retains V14 normalizer.
selection: Final fixed80 epochs each stage; report all3seeds and select ADE median separately per configuration. Two independent complete training runs must reproduce weights, optimizer, RNG, losses and predictions.

decision_bootstrap.interpretation: Group-equal fresh-development descriptive intervals; not untouched holdout or control performance.

required_comparisons: same geometry library response vs own frozen motion
same geometry library vs motion-only selected median
original actual vs geometry library with unchanged GRU/CV to separate library effect
later_required: Offline research eligibility only. Whole module off/refusal/failure exact original equivalence, untouched holdout, actual sequential/self-generated local candidates, original8Levels and new-scene closed-loop capture/safety/latency before any promotion.
